caption: The drawing shows a single decorative chair with a wooden frame, depicted in reddish-brown tones. The chair has intricately carved details on the legs, seat frame, and backrest edges. Both the backrest and the seat are upholstered in dark brown fabric that features a colorful, patterned design of flowers and leaves in shades of green, blue, yellow, and pink. The chair has four legs, each with ornamental carvings, and the overall composition is centered on a plain, light background with no other objects or details visible.
title: Chair
